#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""2026 Azerbaijan GP Monte Carlo forecast."""
import json
import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict

rng = np.random.default_rng(20260926)

DRIVERS = [
    "RUS","LEC","PIA","HAD","NOR","HAM","GAS","VER","COL","BEA",
    "LAW","ALB","OCO","SAI","LIN","ANT","BOR","HUL","BOT","PER","ALO","STR",
]
N = len(DRIVERS)
IDX = {d: i for i, d in enumerate(DRIVERS)}
GRID = {d: i + 1 for i, d in enumerate(DRIVERS)}  # 1-indexed

# Race pace (s/lap vs theoretical Mercedes/Russell). Lower is faster.
# Team long-run (F1): MER 0, MCL +0.05, RBR +0.30, FER +0.34, ALP +0.99
PACE = {
    "RUS": 0.00,   # strongest weekend, pole, Mercedes
    "ANT": 0.03,   # same car, slightly less hooked-up this weekend
    "NOR": 0.07,   # McLaren race pace, elite Sunday
    "PIA": 0.08,   # McLaren, P3, upgrade working
    "VER": 0.20,   # Red Bull + driver; power-ok case
    "LEC": 0.28,   # Ferrari; hopes race > quali; Baku specialist
    "HAM": 0.35,   # Ferrari
    "HAD": 0.36,   # Red Bull car, rust + wrist caution
    "GAS": 0.95,   # Alpine, comfortable, Q3
    "COL": 1.08,   # Alpine, lock-up, less comfortable on brakes
    "LAW": 1.18,   # Racing Bulls
    "LIN": 1.26,   # RB, FP2 castle crash, limited running
    "BEA": 1.22,   # Haas, Q2 0.092 from Q3
    "OCO": 1.30,   # Haas
    "SAI": 1.38,   # Williams upgrade, Q3 overachievement risk
    "ALB": 1.48,   # Williams
    "HUL": 1.62,   # Audi Q1
    "BOR": 1.68,   # Audi Q1
    "PER": 2.00,   # Cadillac, Baku specialist in a slow car
    "BOT": 2.22,   # Cadillac
    "ALO": 2.65,   # Aston-Honda disaster + elite driver
    "STR": 2.95,   # Aston, slow + error-prone
}
VER_PACE_BAD = 0.55  # still down on power

# Start biases (positive = lose places into T1). RB launches poor.
START_BIAS = {
    "RUS": -0.15, "LEC": 0.05, "PIA": 0.00, "HAD": 1.25, "NOR": -0.10,
    "HAM": -0.20, "GAS": 0.10, "VER": 0.90, "COL": 0.25, "BEA": 0.15,
    "LAW": 0.10, "ALB": 0.05, "OCO": 0.10, "SAI": 0.20, "LIN": 0.35,
    "ANT": 0.40,  # pack, not a launch problem — traffic/contact
    "BOR": 0.15, "HUL": 0.05, "BOT": 0.10, "PER": 0.15, "ALO": 0.10, "STR": 0.35,
}

# Mechanical + crash retirement (race, not DNS)
# Baku walls + heavy braking. ANT rebuild (FP1 hydraulic/fire + Q1 crash).
RET = {
    "RUS": 0.125, "LEC": 0.145, "PIA": 0.135, "HAD": 0.195, "NOR": 0.135,
    "HAM": 0.150, "GAS": 0.145, "VER": 0.155, "COL": 0.170, "BEA": 0.185,
    "LAW": 0.165, "ALB": 0.155, "OCO": 0.155, "SAI": 0.175, "LIN": 0.230,
    "ANT": 0.235,  # hydraulic, fire-damaged PU change, Q1 crash rebuild
    "BOR": 0.175, "HUL": 0.160, "BOT": 0.225, "PER": 0.245, "ALO": 0.270, "STR": 0.330,
}
# Extra crash share of retirement (rest mechanical). Used for timing.
CRASH_SHARE = {
    "RUS": 0.35, "LEC": 0.40, "PIA": 0.38, "HAD": 0.50, "NOR": 0.38,
    "HAM": 0.35, "GAS": 0.40, "VER": 0.35, "COL": 0.48, "BEA": 0.50,
    "LAW": 0.42, "ALB": 0.38, "OCO": 0.38, "SAI": 0.48, "LIN": 0.60,
    "ANT": 0.30,  # more mechanical than wall given rebuild
    "BOR": 0.45, "HUL": 0.38, "BOT": 0.35, "PER": 0.40, "ALO": 0.35, "STR": 0.55,
}
DNS = {
    "RUS": 0.004, "LEC": 0.005, "PIA": 0.005, "HAD": 0.010, "NOR": 0.005,
    "HAM": 0.006, "GAS": 0.006, "VER": 0.006, "COL": 0.008, "BEA": 0.010,
    "LAW": 0.007, "ALB": 0.007, "OCO": 0.007, "SAI": 0.008, "LIN": 0.014,
    "ANT": 0.018,  # overnight repair of crash + previous PU drama
    "BOR": 0.008, "HUL": 0.007, "BOT": 0.012, "PER": 0.012, "ALO": 0.014, "STR": 0.022,
}
DSQ = {d: 0.0045 if GRID[d] <= 8 else 0.0030 for d in DRIVERS}
DSQ["RUS"] = 0.0055  # plank risk if they run it low for the pole pace
DSQ["ANT"] = 0.0050

N_SIM = 250_000

# Regime probabilities. Pirelli ~89% SC historically high; use 78% ≥1 SC
# to avoid Madrid-style overfit to support-series chaos, but Baku F1 itself is messy.
P_GREEN = 0.22
P_SINGLE = 0.43
P_CHAOS = 0.35

# Stickiness (seconds-equivalent per grid slot) and score noise by regime
# score = pace + stick * (pos-1) + noise; lower better
PARAMS = {
    "green":  dict(stick=0.070, noise=0.22, t1=0.12),
    "single": dict(stick=0.042, noise=0.42, t1=0.16),
    "chaos":  dict(stick=0.018, noise=0.85, t1=0.22),
}

def simulate():
    pos_counts = np.zeros((N, 22), dtype=np.int64)
    nc_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
    dns_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
    dsq_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
    ret_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)  # race retirement (nc or classified DNF)

    pace_arr = np.array([PACE[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    start_bias = np.array([START_BIAS[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    ret_p = np.array([RET[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    crash_sh = np.array([CRASH_SHARE[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    dns_p = np.array([DNS[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    dsq_p = np.array([DSQ[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    grid_pos = np.arange(1, N + 1, dtype=float)

    for s in range(N_SIM):
        u = rng.random()
        if u < P_GREEN:
            regime = "green"
        elif u < P_GREEN + P_SINGLE:
            regime = "single"
        else:
            regime = "chaos"
        par = PARAMS[regime]

        # Verstappen power: 70% fixed overnight, 30% still down
        pace = pace_arr.copy()
        if rng.random() > 0.70:
            pace[IDX["VER"]] = VER_PACE_BAD

        # DNS
        is_dns = rng.random(N) < dns_p
        # DSQ among those who start (approx independent, rare)
        is_dsq = (~is_dns) & (rng.random(N) < dsq_p)

        active = ~(is_dns | is_dsq)

        # Start shuffle
        start_pos = grid_pos + start_bias + rng.normal(0, 0.85, N)

        # T1 pack incident
        if rng.random() < par["t1"]:
            # candidates in the pack (grid 6-20)
            cand = np.where((grid_pos >= 6) & (grid_pos <= 20) & active)[0]
            if len(cand) >= 2:
                n_hit = int(rng.integers(2, min(5, len(cand)) + 1))
                hit = rng.choice(cand, size=n_hit, replace=False)
                # 35% of hits retire immediately (opening lap NC)
                for h in hit:
                    if rng.random() < 0.35:
                        # opening-lap retirement
                        ret_counts[h] += 1
                        nc_counts[h] += 1
                        active[h] = False
                    else:
                        # damage: inflate pace
                        pace[h] += rng.uniform(0.4, 1.8)
                        start_pos[h] += rng.uniform(1.0, 4.0)

        # Retirements among remaining active (not T1 already handled)
        # Hazard: some early (NC), some late (classified)
        will_ret = active & (rng.random(N) < ret_p)
        # ANT extra if chaos doesn't come — already in rate
        # Timing: crash more early, mechanical mixed
        early = np.zeros(N, dtype=bool)
        late = np.zeros(N, dtype=bool)
        for i in np.where(will_ret)[0]:
            # P(NC | ret) ~ 0.86, remainder classified late DNF
            if rng.random() < 0.86:
                early[i] = True
            else:
                late[i] = True

        for i in np.where(early)[0]:
            ret_counts[i] += 1
            nc_counts[i] += 1
            active[i] = False

        # Race scores for remaining active (including late DNF, who still classify)
        still = np.where(active)[0]
        if still.size == 0:
            # extremely rare: everyone dns/dsq/nc
            for i in np.where(is_dns)[0]:
                dns_counts[i] += 1
            for i in np.where(is_dsq)[0]:
                dsq_counts[i] += 1
            continue

        # Pit-lottery / SC luck
        if regime == "green":
            luck = rng.normal(0, par["noise"], N)
        elif regime == "single":
            luck = rng.normal(0, par["noise"], N)
            # cars that "want" an early stop benefit; hard-long-stint hurt
            # ANT, VER, HUL, COL more likely alternative; leaders can lose if SC right after pit entry
            luck[IDX["ANT"]] -= rng.uniform(0.0, 0.35)  # alternative strategy option
            luck[IDX["VER"]] -= rng.uniform(0.0, 0.20)
            if rng.random() < 0.22:
                # classic pit-entry lottery vs leader
                luck[IDX["RUS"]] += rng.uniform(0.15, 0.55)
                luck[IDX["LEC"]] -= rng.uniform(0.05, 0.30)
                luck[IDX["PIA"]] -= rng.uniform(0.05, 0.30)
        else:
            luck = rng.normal(0, par["noise"], N)
            luck[IDX["ANT"]] -= rng.uniform(0.1, 0.6)
            luck[IDX["VER"]] -= rng.uniform(0.05, 0.35)

        score = pace + par["stick"] * (start_pos - 1.0) + luck
        # late DNFs: they classify but at the back of those still running
        # model as huge score penalty so they take last classified slots
        score[late] += 8.0 + rng.normal(0, 0.3, N)[late]

        order = still[np.argsort(score[still])]
        for rank, i in enumerate(order):
            pos_counts[i, rank] += 1
        for i in np.where(late)[0]:
            ret_counts[i] += 1

        for i in np.where(is_dns)[0]:
            dns_counts[i] += 1
        for i in np.where(is_dsq)[0]:
            dsq_counts[i] += 1

    return pos_counts, nc_counts, dns_counts, dsq_counts, ret_counts

pos_counts, nc_counts, dns_counts, dsq_counts, ret_counts = simulate()

# Convert to probabilities
pos = pos_counts / N_SIM
nc = nc_counts / N_SIM
dns = dns_counts / N_SIM
dsq = dsq_counts / N_SIM
ret = ret_counts / N_SIM

# Repair each driver to sum 1 (floating)
for i in range(N):
    s = pos[i].sum() + nc[i] + dns[i] + dsq[i]
    if s <= 0:
        raise RuntimeError(DRIVERS[i])
    pos[i] /= s
    nc[i] /= s
    dns[i] /= s
    dsq[i] /= s
    # ret is separate; leave as empirical (may slightly exceed nc)

def round_field(pos, nc, dns, dsq, ret, nd=5):
    """Round to nd decimals, repair driver sums and position caps/monotonicity."""
    pos_r = np.round(pos, nd)
    nc_r = np.round(nc, nd)
    dns_r = np.round(dns, nd)
    dsq_r = np.round(dsq, nd)
    ret_r = np.round(ret, nd)

    # Driver sums -> 1 by adjusting the largest position mass
    for i in range(N):
        s = pos_r[i].sum() + nc_r[i] + dns_r[i] + dsq_r[i]
        diff = np.round(1.0 - s, nd)
        if diff == 0:
            continue
        # add to the mode position if classified mass exists
        j = int(np.argmax(pos_r[i]))
        pos_r[i, j] = np.round(pos_r[i, j] + diff, nd)
        if pos_r[i, j] < 0:
            pos_r[i, j] = 0
            nc_r[i] = np.round(nc_r[i] + (1.0 - (pos_r[i].sum() + dns_r[i] + dsq_r[i])), nd)

    # Clip to [0,1]
    pos_r = np.clip(pos_r, 0, 1)
    nc_r = np.clip(nc_r, 0, 1)
    dns_r = np.clip(dns_r, 0, 1)
    dsq_r = np.clip(dsq_r, 0, 1)
    ret_r = np.clip(ret_r, 0, 1)

    # Position totals <= 1: scale down if needed
    for k in range(22):
        tot = pos_r[:, k].sum()
        if tot > 1.0 + 1e-12:
            pos_r[:, k] *= 1.0 / tot
            pos_r[:, k] = np.round(pos_r[:, k], nd)
            # leftover to 1: add to largest
            leftover = np.round(1.0 - pos_r[:, k].sum(), nd)
            if leftover != 0:
                i = int(np.argmax(pos_r[:, k]))
                pos_r[i, k] = np.round(pos_r[i, k] + leftover, nd)

    # Monotonic occupancy: occ[k] >= occ[k+1]
    occ = pos_r.sum(axis=0)
    for k in range(21):
        if occ[k+1] > occ[k] + 1e-12:
            # scale down k+1
            scale = occ[k] / occ[k+1] if occ[k+1] > 0 else 0
            pos_r[:, k+1] = np.round(pos_r[:, k+1] * scale, nd)
            occ = pos_r.sum(axis=0)

    # Re-fix driver sums after position repairs: dump remainder into nc
    for i in range(N):
        s = pos_r[i].sum() + nc_r[i] + dns_r[i] + dsq_r[i]
        diff = np.round(1.0 - s, nd)
        if abs(diff) > 0:
            nc_r[i] = np.round(nc_r[i] + diff, nd)
            if nc_r[i] < 0:
                # take from tail positions
                need = -nc_r[i]
                nc_r[i] = 0.0
                for k in range(21, -1, -1):
                    take = min(pos_r[i, k], need)
                    pos_r[i, k] = np.round(pos_r[i, k] - take, nd)
                    need = np.round(need - take, nd)
                    if need <= 0:
                        break

    return pos_r, nc_r, dns_r, dsq_r, ret_r

pos_r, nc_r, dns_r, dsq_r, ret_r = round_field(pos, nc, dns, dsq, ret, nd=5)

print("=== WIN PROBS ===")
wins = [(DRIVERS[i], pos_r[i,0]) for i in range(N)]
wins.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
for d,w in wins:
    print(f"  {d:3} {w:.5f}")
print("win sum", sum(w for _,w in wins))

print("\n=== PODIUM / T10 / RET / EXP ===")
print(f"{'id':4} {'win':7} {'pod':7} {'t5':7} {'t10':7} {'ret':7} {'exp':6} {'nc':7} {'dns':6}")
exp_list = []
for i,d in enumerate(DRIVERS):
    win = pos_r[i,0]
    pod = pos_r[i,:3].sum()
    t5 = pos_r[i,:5].sum()
    t10 = pos_r[i,:10].sum()
    s = pos_r[i].sum()
    exp = (pos_r[i] * np.arange(1,23)).sum() / s if s>0 else 99
    # expected rank treating nc/dns/dsq as 23
    exp_all = (pos_r[i] * np.arange(1,23)).sum() + 23*(nc_r[i]+dns_r[i]+dsq_r[i])
    exp_list.append((d, exp, exp_all, win, pod, t10, ret_r[i]))
    print(f"{d:4} {win:7.4f} {pod:7.4f} {t5:7.4f} {t10:7.4f} {ret_r[i]:7.4f} {exp:6.2f} {nc_r[i]:7.4f} {dns_r[i]:6.4f}")

print("\n=== POSITION OCCUPANCY ===")
occ = pos_r.sum(axis=0)
for k in range(22):
    print(f"P{k+1:02d} {occ[k]:.5f}")

print("\n=== DRIVER SUMS ===")
for i,d in enumerate(DRIVERS):
    s = pos_r[i].sum()+nc_r[i]+dns_r[i]+dsq_r[i]
    print(d, round(s,6), "minpos", pos_r[i].min(), "ret", ret_r[i])

print("\nE[classified]", occ.sum())
print("E[nc]", nc_r.sum(), "E[dns]", dns_r.sum(), "E[dsq]", dsq_r.sum(), "E[ret]", ret_r.sum())

# order by expected classified position (then by exp_all)
order = sorted(range(N), key=lambda i: (
    (pos_r[i]*np.arange(1,23)).sum() / max(pos_r[i].sum(), 1e-12)
    + 3.0*(nc_r[i]+dns_r[i]+dsq_r[i])  # DNF-prone slide a bit
))
print("\nORDER", [DRIVERS[i] for i in order])

# save raw
np.savez("/workspace/baku_raw.npz", pos=pos_r, nc=nc_r, dns=dns_r, dsq=dsq_r, ret=ret_r, drivers=np.array(DRIVERS))
print("saved")
END

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""2026 Azerbaijan GP Monte Carlo forecast."""
import json
import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict

rng = np.random.default_rng(20260926)

DRIVERS = [
    "RUS","LEC","PIA","HAD","NOR","HAM","GAS","VER","COL","BEA",
    "LAW","ALB","OCO","SAI","LIN","ANT","BOR","HUL","BOT","PER","ALO","STR",
]
N = len(DRIVERS)
IDX = {d: i for i, d in enumerate(DRIVERS)}
GRID = {d: i + 1 for i, d in enumerate(DRIVERS)}  # 1-indexed

# Race pace (s/lap vs theoretical Mercedes/Russell). Lower is faster.
# Team long-run (F1): MER 0, MCL +0.05, RBR +0.30, FER +0.34, ALP +0.99
PACE = {
    "RUS": 0.00,   # strongest weekend, pole, Mercedes
    "ANT": 0.03,   # same car, slightly less hooked-up this weekend
    "NOR": 0.07,   # McLaren race pace, elite Sunday
    "PIA": 0.08,   # McLaren, P3, upgrade working
    "VER": 0.20,   # Red Bull + driver; power-ok case
    "LEC": 0.28,   # Ferrari; hopes race > quali; Baku specialist
    "HAM": 0.35,   # Ferrari
    "HAD": 0.36,   # Red Bull car, rust + wrist caution
    "GAS": 0.95,   # Alpine, comfortable, Q3
    "COL": 1.08,   # Alpine, lock-up, less comfortable on brakes
    "LAW": 1.18,   # Racing Bulls
    "LIN": 1.26,   # RB, FP2 castle crash, limited running
    "BEA": 1.22,   # Haas, Q2 0.092 from Q3
    "OCO": 1.30,   # Haas
    "SAI": 1.38,   # Williams upgrade, Q3 overachievement risk
    "ALB": 1.48,   # Williams
    "HUL": 1.62,   # Audi Q1
    "BOR": 1.68,   # Audi Q1
    "PER": 2.00,   # Cadillac, Baku specialist in a slow car
    "BOT": 2.22,   # Cadillac
    "ALO": 2.65,   # Aston-Honda disaster + elite driver
    "STR": 2.95,   # Aston, slow + error-prone
}
VER_PACE_BAD = 0.55  # still down on power

# Start biases (positive = lose places into T1). RB launches poor.
START_BIAS = {
    "RUS": -0.15, "LEC": 0.05, "PIA": 0.00, "HAD": 1.25, "NOR": -0.10,
    "HAM": -0.20, "GAS": 0.10, "VER": 0.90, "COL": 0.25, "BEA": 0.15,
    "LAW": 0.10, "ALB": 0.05, "OCO": 0.10, "SAI": 0.20, "LIN": 0.35,
    "ANT": 0.40,  # pack, not a launch problem — traffic/contact
    "BOR": 0.15, "HUL": 0.05, "BOT": 0.10, "PER": 0.15, "ALO": 0.10, "STR": 0.35,
}

# Mechanical + crash retirement (race, not DNS)
# Baku walls + heavy braking. ANT rebuild (FP1 hydraulic/fire + Q1 crash).
RET = {
    "RUS": 0.125, "LEC": 0.145, "PIA": 0.135, "HAD": 0.195, "NOR": 0.135,
    "HAM": 0.150, "GAS": 0.145, "VER": 0.155, "COL": 0.170, "BEA": 0.185,
    "LAW": 0.165, "ALB": 0.155, "OCO": 0.155, "SAI": 0.175, "LIN": 0.230,
    "ANT": 0.235,  # hydraulic, fire-damaged PU change, Q1 crash rebuild
    "BOR": 0.175, "HUL": 0.160, "BOT": 0.225, "PER": 0.245, "ALO": 0.270, "STR": 0.330,
}
# Extra crash share of retirement (rest mechanical). Used for timing.
CRASH_SHARE = {
    "RUS": 0.35, "LEC": 0.40, "PIA": 0.38, "HAD": 0.50, "NOR": 0.38,
    "HAM": 0.35, "GAS": 0.40, "VER": 0.35, "COL": 0.48, "BEA": 0.50,
    "LAW": 0.42, "ALB": 0.38, "OCO": 0.38, "SAI": 0.48, "LIN": 0.60,
    "ANT": 0.30,  # more mechanical than wall given rebuild
    "BOR": 0.45, "HUL": 0.38, "BOT": 0.35, "PER": 0.40, "ALO": 0.35, "STR": 0.55,
}
DNS = {
    "RUS": 0.004, "LEC": 0.005, "PIA": 0.005, "HAD": 0.010, "NOR": 0.005,
    "HAM": 0.006, "GAS": 0.006, "VER": 0.006, "COL": 0.008, "BEA": 0.010,
    "LAW": 0.007, "ALB": 0.007, "OCO": 0.007, "SAI": 0.008, "LIN": 0.014,
    "ANT": 0.018,  # overnight repair of crash + previous PU drama
    "BOR": 0.008, "HUL": 0.007, "BOT": 0.012, "PER": 0.012, "ALO": 0.014, "STR": 0.022,
}
DSQ = {d: 0.0045 if GRID[d] <= 8 else 0.0030 for d in DRIVERS}
DSQ["RUS"] = 0.0055  # plank risk if they run it low for the pole pace
DSQ["ANT"] = 0.0050

N_SIM = 250_000

# Regime probabilities. Pirelli ~89% SC historically high; use 78% ≥1 SC
# to avoid Madrid-style overfit to support-series chaos, but Baku F1 itself is messy.
P_GREEN = 0.22
P_SINGLE = 0.43
P_CHAOS = 0.35

# Stickiness (seconds-equivalent per grid slot) and score noise by regime
# score = pace + stick * (pos-1) + noise; lower better
PARAMS = {
    "green":  dict(stick=0.070, noise=0.22, t1=0.12),
    "single": dict(stick=0.042, noise=0.42, t1=0.16),
    "chaos":  dict(stick=0.018, noise=0.85, t1=0.22),
}

def simulate():
    pos_counts = np.zeros((N, 22), dtype=np.int64)
    nc_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
    dns_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
    dsq_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
    ret_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)  # race retirement (nc or classified DNF)

    pace_arr = np.array([PACE[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    start_bias = np.array([START_BIAS[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    ret_p = np.array([RET[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    crash_sh = np.array([CRASH_SHARE[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    dns_p = np.array([DNS[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    dsq_p = np.array([DSQ[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    grid_pos = np.arange(1, N + 1, dtype=float)

    for s in range(N_SIM):
        u = rng.random()
        if u < P_GREEN:
            regime = "green"
        elif u < P_GREEN + P_SINGLE:
            regime = "single"
        else:
            regime = "chaos"
        par = PARAMS[regime]

        # Verstappen power: 70% fixed overnight, 30% still down
        pace = pace_arr.copy()
        if rng.random() > 0.70:
            pace[IDX["VER"]] = VER_PACE_BAD

        # DNS
        is_dns = rng.random(N) < dns_p
        # DSQ among those who start (approx independent, rare)
        is_dsq = (~is_dns) & (rng.random(N) < dsq_p)

        active = ~(is_dns | is_dsq)

        # Start shuffle
        start_pos = grid_pos + start_bias + rng.normal(0, 0.85, N)

        # T1 pack incident
        if rng.random() < par["t1"]:
            # candidates in the pack (grid 6-20)
            cand = np.where((grid_pos >= 6) & (grid_pos <= 20) & active)[0]
            if len(cand) >= 2:
                n_hit = int(rng.integers(2, min(5, len(cand)) + 1))
                hit = rng.choice(cand, size=n_hit, replace=False)
                # 35% of hits retire immediately (opening lap NC)
                for h in hit:
                    if rng.random() < 0.35:
                        # opening-lap retirement
                        ret_counts[h] += 1
                        nc_counts[h] += 1
                        active[h] = False
                    else:
                        # damage: inflate pace
                        pace[h] += rng.uniform(0.4, 1.8)
                        start_pos[h] += rng.uniform(1.0, 4.0)

        # Retirements among remaining active (not T1 already handled)
        # Hazard: some early (NC), some late (classified)
        will_ret = active & (rng.random(N) < ret_p)
        # ANT extra if chaos doesn't come — already in rate
        # Timing: crash more early, mechanical mixed
        early = np.zeros(N, dtype=bool)
        late = np.zeros(N, dtype=bool)
        for i in np.where(will_ret)[0]:
            # P(NC | ret) ~ 0.86, remainder classified late DNF
            if rng.random() < 0.86:
                early[i] = True
            else:
                late[i] = True

        for i in np.where(early)[0]:
            ret_counts[i] += 1
            nc_counts[i] += 1
            active[i] = False

        # Race scores for remaining active (including late DNF, who still classify)
        still = np.where(active)[0]
        if still.size == 0:
            # extremely rare: everyone dns/dsq/nc
            for i in np.where(is_dns)[0]:
                dns_counts[i] += 1
            for i in np.where(is_dsq)[0]:
                dsq_counts[i] += 1
            continue

        # Pit-lottery / SC luck
        if regime == "green":
            luck = rng.normal(0, par["noise"], N)
        elif regime == "single":
            luck = rng.normal(0, par["noise"], N)
            # cars that "want" an early stop benefit; hard-long-stint hurt
            # ANT, VER, HUL, COL more likely alternative; leaders can lose if SC right after pit entry
            luck[IDX["ANT"]] -= rng.uniform(0.0, 0.35)  # alternative strategy option
            luck[IDX["VER"]] -= rng.uniform(0.0, 0.20)
            if rng.random() < 0.22:
                # classic pit-entry lottery vs leader
                luck[IDX["RUS"]] += rng.uniform(0.15, 0.55)
                luck[IDX["LEC"]] -= rng.uniform(0.05, 0.30)
                luck[IDX["PIA"]] -= rng.uniform(0.05, 0.30)
        else:
            luck = rng.normal(0, par["noise"], N)
            luck[IDX["ANT"]] -= rng.uniform(0.1, 0.6)
            luck[IDX["VER"]] -= rng.uniform(0.05, 0.35)

        score = pace + par["stick"] * (start_pos - 1.0) + luck
        # late DNFs: they classify but at the back of those still running
        # model as huge score penalty so they take last classified slots
        score[late] += 8.0 + rng.normal(0, 0.3, N)[late]

        order = still[np.argsort(score[still])]
        for rank, i in enumerate(order):
            pos_counts[i, rank] += 1
        for i in np.where(late)[0]:
            ret_counts[i] += 1

        for i in np.where(is_dns)[0]:
            dns_counts[i] += 1
        for i in np.where(is_dsq)[0]:
            dsq_counts[i] += 1

    return pos_counts, nc_counts, dns_counts, dsq_counts, ret_counts

pos_counts, nc_counts, dns_counts, dsq_counts, ret_counts = simulate()

# Convert to probabilities
pos = pos_counts / N_SIM
nc = nc_counts / N_SIM
dns = dns_counts / N_SIM
dsq = dsq_counts / N_SIM
ret = ret_counts / N_SIM

# Repair each driver to sum 1 (floating)
for i in range(N):
    s = pos[i].sum() + nc[i] + dns[i] + dsq[i]
    if s <= 0:
        raise RuntimeError(DRIVERS[i])
    pos[i] /= s
    nc[i] /= s
    dns[i] /= s
    dsq[i] /= s
    # ret is separate; leave as empirical (may slightly exceed nc)

def round_field(pos, nc, dns, dsq, ret, nd=5):
    """Round to nd decimals, repair driver sums and position caps/monotonicity."""
    pos_r = np.round(pos, nd)
    nc_r = np.round(nc, nd)
    dns_r = np.round(dns, nd)
    dsq_r = np.round(dsq, nd)
    ret_r = np.round(ret, nd)

    # Driver sums -> 1 by adjusting the largest position mass
    for i in range(N):
        s = pos_r[i].sum() + nc_r[i] + dns_r[i] + dsq_r[i]
        diff = np.round(1.0 - s, nd)
        if diff == 0:
            continue
        # add to the mode position if classified mass exists
        j = int(np.argmax(pos_r[i]))
        pos_r[i, j] = np.round(pos_r[i, j] + diff, nd)
        if pos_r[i, j] < 0:
            pos_r[i, j] = 0
            nc_r[i] = np.round(nc_r[i] + (1.0 - (pos_r[i].sum() + dns_r[i] + dsq_r[i])), nd)

    # Clip to [0,1]
    pos_r = np.clip(pos_r, 0, 1)
    nc_r = np.clip(nc_r, 0, 1)
    dns_r = np.clip(dns_r, 0, 1)
    dsq_r = np.clip(dsq_r, 0, 1)
    ret_r = np.clip(ret_r, 0, 1)

    # Position totals <= 1: scale down if needed
    for k in range(22):
        tot = pos_r[:, k].sum()
        if tot > 1.0 + 1e-12:
            pos_r[:, k] *= 1.0 / tot
            pos_r[:, k] = np.round(pos_r[:, k], nd)
            # leftover to 1: add to largest
            leftover = np.round(1.0 - pos_r[:, k].sum(), nd)
            if leftover != 0:
                i = int(np.argmax(pos_r[:, k]))
                pos_r[i, k] = np.round(pos_r[i, k] + leftover, nd)

    # Monotonic occupancy: occ[k] >= occ[k+1]
    occ = pos_r.sum(axis=0)
    for k in range(21):
        if occ[k+1] > occ[k] + 1e-12:
            # scale down k+1
            scale = occ[k] / occ[k+1] if occ[k+1] > 0 else 0
            pos_r[:, k+1] = np.round(pos_r[:, k+1] * scale, nd)
            occ = pos_r.sum(axis=0)

    # Re-fix driver sums after position repairs: dump remainder into nc
    for i in range(N):
        s = pos_r[i].sum() + nc_r[i] + dns_r[i] + dsq_r[i]
        diff = np.round(1.0 - s, nd)
        if abs(diff) > 0:
            nc_r[i] = np.round(nc_r[i] + diff, nd)
            if nc_r[i] < 0:
                # take from tail positions
                need = -nc_r[i]
                nc_r[i] = 0.0
                for k in range(21, -1, -1):
                    take = min(pos_r[i, k], need)
                    pos_r[i, k] = np.round(pos_r[i, k] - take, nd)
                    need = np.round(need - take, nd)
                    if need <= 0:
                        break

    return pos_r, nc_r, dns_r, dsq_r, ret_r

pos_r, nc_r, dns_r, dsq_r, ret_r = round_field(pos, nc, dns, dsq, ret, nd=5)

print("=== WIN PROBS ===")
wins = [(DRIVERS[i], pos_r[i,0]) for i in range(N)]
wins.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
for d,w in wins:
    print(f"  {d:3} {w:.5f}")
print("win sum", sum(w for _,w in wins))

print("\n=== PODIUM / T10 / RET / EXP ===")
print(f"{'id':4} {'win':7} {'pod':7} {'t5':7} {'t10':7} {'ret':7} {'exp':6} {'nc':7} {'dns':6}")
exp_list = []
for i,d in enumerate(DRIVERS):
    win = pos_r[i,0]
    pod = pos_r[i,:3].sum()
    t5 = pos_r[i,:5].sum()
    t10 = pos_r[i,:10].sum()
    s = pos_r[i].sum()
    exp = (pos_r[i] * np.arange(1,23)).sum() / s if s>0 else 99
    # expected rank treating nc/dns/dsq as 23
    exp_all = (pos_r[i] * np.arange(1,23)).sum() + 23*(nc_r[i]+dns_r[i]+dsq_r[i])
    exp_list.append((d, exp, exp_all, win, pod, t10, ret_r[i]))
    print(f"{d:4} {win:7.4f} {pod:7.4f} {t5:7.4f} {t10:7.4f} {ret_r[i]:7.4f} {exp:6.2f} {nc_r[i]:7.4f} {dns_r[i]:6.4f}")

print("\n=== POSITION OCCUPANCY ===")
occ = pos_r.sum(axis=0)
for k in range(22):
    print(f"P{k+1:02d} {occ[k]:.5f}")

print("\n=== DRIVER SUMS ===")
for i,d in enumerate(DRIVERS):
    s = pos_r[i].sum()+nc_r[i]+dns_r[i]+dsq_r[i]
    print(d, round(s,6), "minpos", pos_r[i].min(), "ret", ret_r[i])

print("\nE[classified]", occ.sum())
print("E[nc]", nc_r.sum(), "E[dns]", dns_r.sum(), "E[dsq]", dsq_r.sum(), "E[ret]", ret_r.sum())

# order by expected classified position (then by exp_all)
order = sorted(range(N), key=lambda i: (
    (pos_r[i]*np.arange(1,23)).sum() / max(pos_r[i].sum(), 1e-12)
    + 3.0*(nc_r[i]+dns_r[i]+dsq_r[i])  # DNF-prone slide a bit
))
print("\nORDER", [DRIVERS[i] for i in order])

# save raw
np.savez("/workspace/baku_raw.npz", pos=pos_r, nc=nc_r, dns=dns_r, dsq=dsq_r, ret=ret_r, drivers=np.array(DRIVERS))
print("saved")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""2026 Azerbaijan GP Monte Carlo forecast."""
import json
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(20260926)

DRIVERS = [
    "RUS","LEC","PIA","HAD","NOR","HAM","GAS","VER","COL","BEA",
    "LAW","ALB","OCO","SAI","LIN","ANT","BOR","HUL","BOT","PER","ALO","STR",
]
N = len(DRIVERS)
IDX = {d: i for i, d in enumerate(DRIVERS)}

# Race pace s/lap vs Mercedes baseline (F1 long-run: MER 0, MCL +0.05, RBR +0.30, FER +0.34, ALP +0.99)
PACE = {
    "RUS": 0.00,
    "ANT": 0.04,
    "NOR": 0.08,
    "PIA": 0.09,
    "VER": 0.22,      # power-ok
    "LEC": 0.30,
    "HAM": 0.36,
    "HAD": 0.40,      # rust + wrist
    "GAS": 0.96,
    "COL": 1.10,
    "BEA": 1.24,
    "LAW": 1.20,
    "LIN": 1.30,
    "OCO": 1.32,
    "SAI": 1.40,
    "ALB": 1.50,
    "HUL": 1.64,
    "BOR": 1.70,
    "PER": 2.02,
    "BOT": 2.24,
    "ALO": 2.68,
    "STR": 2.98,
}
VER_PACE_BAD = 0.58

START_BIAS = {
    "RUS": -0.20, "LEC": 0.05, "PIA": 0.00, "HAD": 1.45, "NOR": -0.10,
    "HAM": -0.25, "GAS": 0.10, "VER": 1.00, "COL": 0.30, "BEA": 0.20,
    "LAW": 0.10, "ALB": 0.05, "OCO": 0.10, "SAI": 0.25, "LIN": 0.40,
    "ANT": 0.45,
    "BOR": 0.15, "HUL": 0.05, "BOT": 0.10, "PER": 0.15, "ALO": 0.10, "STR": 0.40,
}

RET = {
    "RUS": 0.122, "LEC": 0.142, "PIA": 0.132, "HAD": 0.190, "NOR": 0.132,
    "HAM": 0.148, "GAS": 0.142, "VER": 0.152, "COL": 0.168, "BEA": 0.182,
    "LAW": 0.162, "ALB": 0.152, "OCO": 0.152, "SAI": 0.172, "LIN": 0.225,
    "ANT": 0.225,
    "BOR": 0.172, "HUL": 0.158, "BOT": 0.220, "PER": 0.240, "ALO": 0.265, "STR": 0.325,
}
DNS = {
    "RUS": 0.004, "LEC": 0.005, "PIA": 0.005, "HAD": 0.010, "NOR": 0.005,
    "HAM": 0.006, "GAS": 0.006, "VER": 0.006, "COL": 0.008, "BEA": 0.010,
    "LAW": 0.007, "ALB": 0.007, "OCO": 0.007, "SAI": 0.008, "LIN": 0.014,
    "ANT": 0.016,
    "BOR": 0.008, "HUL": 0.007, "BOT": 0.012, "PER": 0.012, "ALO": 0.014, "STR": 0.020,
}
DSQ = {d: 0.0042 if i < 8 else 0.0028 for i, d in enumerate(DRIVERS)}
DSQ["RUS"] = 0.0050
DSQ["ANT"] = 0.0045

N_SIM = 280_000
P_GREEN, P_SINGLE, P_CHAOS = 0.24, 0.44, 0.32
PARAMS = {
    "green":  dict(stick=0.095, noise=0.155, t1=0.11),
    "single": dict(stick=0.048, noise=0.355, t1=0.15),
    "chaos":  dict(stick=0.022, noise=0.68,  t1=0.20),
}

def simulate():
    pos_counts = np.zeros((N, 22), dtype=np.int64)
    nc_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
    dns_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
    dsq_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
    ret_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)

    pace_arr = np.array([PACE[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    start_bias = np.array([START_BIAS[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    ret_p = np.array([RET[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    dns_p = np.array([DNS[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    dsq_p = np.array([DSQ[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    grid_pos = np.arange(1, N + 1, dtype=float)

    for s in range(N_SIM):
        u = rng.random()
        if u < P_GREEN:
            regime = "green"
        elif u < P_GREEN + P_SINGLE:
            regime = "single"
        else:
            regime = "chaos"
        par = PARAMS[regime]

        pace = pace_arr.copy()
        if rng.random() > 0.68:
            pace[IDX["VER"]] = VER_PACE_BAD

        is_dns = rng.random(N) < dns_p
        is_dsq = (~is_dns) & (rng.random(N) < dsq_p)
        active = ~(is_dns | is_dsq)

        start_pos = grid_pos + start_bias + rng.normal(0, 0.80, N)

        if rng.random() < par["t1"]:
            cand = np.where((grid_pos >= 6) & (grid_pos <= 20) & active)[0]
            if len(cand) >= 2:
                n_hit = int(rng.integers(2, min(5, len(cand)) + 1))
                hit = rng.choice(cand, size=n_hit, replace=False)
                for h in hit:
                    if rng.random() < 0.32:
                        ret_counts[h] += 1
                        nc_counts[h] += 1
                        active[h] = False
                    else:
                        pace[h] += rng.uniform(0.35, 1.6)
                        start_pos[h] += rng.uniform(0.8, 3.5)

        will_ret = active & (rng.random(N) < ret_p)
        early = np.zeros(N, dtype=bool)
        late = np.zeros(N, dtype=bool)
        for i in np.where(will_ret)[0]:
            if rng.random() < 0.86:
                early[i] = True
            else:
                late[i] = True
        for i in np.where(early)[0]:
            ret_counts[i] += 1
            nc_counts[i] += 1
            active[i] = False

        still = np.where(active)[0]
        if still.size == 0:
            dns_counts += is_dns.astype(np.int64)
            dsq_counts += is_dsq.astype(np.int64)
            continue

        luck = rng.normal(0, par["noise"], N)
        if regime == "green":
            # Pole + fastest car controls a green Baku more than raw 0.05s race delta implies
            luck[IDX["RUS"]] -= 0.18
        elif regime == "single":
            luck[IDX["ANT"]] -= rng.uniform(0.00, 0.28)
            luck[IDX["VER"]] -= rng.uniform(0.00, 0.16)
            if rng.random() < 0.20:
                luck[IDX["RUS"]] += rng.uniform(0.12, 0.48)
                luck[IDX["LEC"]] -= rng.uniform(0.04, 0.22)
                luck[IDX["PIA"]] -= rng.uniform(0.04, 0.22)
        else:
            luck[IDX["ANT"]] -= rng.uniform(0.08, 0.50)
            luck[IDX["VER"]] -= rng.uniform(0.04, 0.28)

        score = pace + par["stick"] * (start_pos - 1.0) + luck
        score[late] += 8.0 + rng.normal(0, 0.25, N)[late]

        order = still[np.argsort(score[still])]
        for rank, i in enumerate(order):
            pos_counts[i, rank] += 1
        ret_counts[late] += 1
        dns_counts += is_dns.astype(np.int64)
        dsq_counts += is_dsq.astype(np.int64)

    return pos_counts, nc_counts, dns_counts, dsq_counts, ret_counts

pos_counts, nc_counts, dns_counts, dsq_counts, ret_counts = simulate()
pos = pos_counts.astype(float) / N_SIM
nc = nc_counts.astype(float) / N_SIM
dns = dns_counts.astype(float) / N_SIM
dsq = dsq_counts.astype(float) / N_SIM
ret = ret_counts.astype(float) / N_SIM

# Normalize drivers to 1 in float
for i in range(N):
    s = pos[i].sum() + nc[i] + dns[i] + dsq[i]
    pos[i] /= s; nc[i] /= s; dns[i] /= s; dsq[i] /= s

def print_summary(pos, nc, dns, dsq, ret, tag=""):
    print(f"\n===== {tag} =====")
    wins = sorted([(DRIVERS[i], pos[i,0]) for i in range(N)], key=lambda x: -x[1])
    print("WINS", ", ".join(f"{d} {w:.4f}" for d,w in wins[:10]), "sum", sum(w for _,w in wins))
    print(f"{'id':4} {'win':7} {'pod':7} {'t5':7} {'t10':7} {'ret':7} {'expC':6} {'nc':7} {'dns':6} {'sum':7}")
    for i,d in enumerate(DRIVERS):
        s = pos[i].sum()
        exp = (pos[i] * np.arange(1,23)).sum() / s if s>0 else 99
        tot = pos[i].sum()+nc[i]+dns[i]+dsq[i]
        print(f"{d:4} {pos[i,0]:7.4f} {pos[i,:3].sum():7.4f} {pos[i,:5].sum():7.4f} {pos[i,:10].sum():7.4f} {ret[i]:7.4f} {exp:6.2f} {nc[i]:7.4f} {dns[i]:6.4f} {tot:7.5f}")
    occ = pos.sum(axis=0)
    print("OCC", " ".join(f"{occ[k]:.4f}" for k in range(22)))
    print("Eclass", occ.sum(), "Enc", nc.sum(), "Edns", dns.sum(), "Edsq", dsq.sum(), "Eret", ret.sum())
    order = sorted(range(N), key=lambda i: (pos[i]*np.arange(1,23)).sum()/max(pos[i].sum(),1e-12))
    print("ORDER", [DRIVERS[i] for i in order])

print_summary(pos, nc, dns, dsq, ret, "RAW")

# ---- rounding to 5 d.p. with constraint repair ----
ND = 5
scale = 10 ** ND

def to_int_mass(p):
    """Convert probabilities to integer counts of 1e-5 that sum correctly."""
    x = np.round(p * scale).astype(np.int64)
    return x

pos_i = to_int_mass(pos)
nc_i = to_int_mass(nc)
dns_i = to_int_mass(dns)
dsq_i = to_int_mass(dsq)
ret_i = to_int_mass(ret)

# Fix each driver sum to scale
for i in range(N):
    s = pos_i[i].sum() + nc_i[i] + dns_i[i] + dsq_i[i]
    diff = scale - s
    if diff != 0:
        j = int(np.argmax(pos_i[i]))
        pos_i[i, j] += diff

# Force P1..P10 occupancy == scale if we have enough mass, else leave
# First: if a position total > scale, shave from smallest contributors with mass
for k in range(22):
    tot = pos_i[:, k].sum()
    while tot > scale:
        # shave 1 from the driver with largest mass on this pos among those who can move to nc
        i = int(np.argmax(pos_i[:, k]))
        if pos_i[i, k] <= 0:
            break
        pos_i[i, k] -= 1
        nc_i[i] += 1
        tot -= 1

# Monotonic occupancy: occ[k] >= occ[k+1]
occ = pos_i.sum(axis=0)

    "HAM": -0.25, "GAS": 0.10, "VER": 1.00, "COL": 0.30, "BEA": 0.20,

DSQ["RUS"] = 0.0050
DSQ["ANT"] = 0.0045

P_GREEN, P_SINGLE, P_CHAOS = 0.24, 0.44, 0.32

}

    nc_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)

    dns_p = np.array([DNS[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    dsq_p = np.array([DSQ[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    grid_pos = np.arange(1, N + 1, dtype=float)

    for s in range(N_SIM):
        u = rng.random()
        if u < P_GREEN:
            regime = "green"
        elif u < P_GREEN + P_SINGLE:
            regime = "single"
        else:
            regime = "chaos"
        par = PARAMS[regime]

        pace = pace_arr.copy()
        if rng.random() > 0.68:

            ret_counts[i] += 1
            nc_counts[i] += 1
            active[i] = False

            dns_counts += is_dns.astype(np.int64)

            luck[IDX["ANT"]] -= rng.uniform(0.08, 0.50)
            luck[IDX["VER"]] -= rng.uniform(0.04, 0.28)

        score = pace + par["stick"] * (start_pos - 1.0) + luck
        score[late] += 8.0 + rng.normal(0, 0.25, N)[late]

        order = still[np.argsort(score[still])]
        for rank, i in enumerate(order):
            pos_counts[i, rank] += 1
        ret_counts[late] += 1
        dns_counts += is_dns.astype(np.int64)
        dsq_counts += is_dsq.astype(np.int64)

nc = nc_counts.astype(float) / N_SIM
dns = dns_counts.astype(float) / N_SIM
dsq = dsq_counts.astype(float) / N_SIM
ret = ret_counts.astype(float) / N_SIM

        print("BAD driver", d, s, pos_r[i].min(), nc_r[i])

}
DSQ = {d: 0.0042 if i < 8 else 0.0028 for i, d in enumerate(DRIVERS)}
DSQ["RUS"] = 0.0050
DSQ["ANT"] = 0.0045

N_SIM = 280_000
P_GREEN, P_SINGLE, P_CHAOS = 0.24, 0.44, 0.32
PARAMS = {
    "green":  dict(stick=0.095, noise=0.155, t1=0.11),
    "single": dict(stick=0.048, noise=0.355, t1=0.15),
    "chaos":  dict(stick=0.022, noise=0.68,  t1=0.20),
}

def simulate():
    pos_counts = np.zeros((N, 22), dtype=np.int64)
    nc_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
    dns_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
    dsq_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
    ret_counts = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)

    pace_arr = np.array([PACE[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    start_bias = np.array([START_BIAS[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    ret_p = np.array([RET[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    dns_p = np.array([DNS[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    dsq_p = np.array([DSQ[d] for d in DRIVERS])
    grid_pos = np.arange(1, N + 1, dtype=float)

    for s in range(N_SIM):
        u = rng.random()
        if u < P_GREEN:
            regime = "green"
        elif u < P_GREEN + P_SINGLE:
            regime = "single"
        else:
            regime = "chaos"
        par = PARAMS[regime]

        pace = pace_arr.copy()
        if rng.random() > 0.68:
            pace[IDX["VER"]] = VER_PACE_BAD

        is_dns = rng.random(N) < dns_p
        is_dsq = (~is_dns) & (rng.random(N) < dsq_p)
        active = ~(is_dns | is_dsq)

        start_pos = grid_pos + start_bias + rng.normal(0, 0.80, N)

        if rng.random() < par["t1"]:
            cand = np.where((grid_pos >= 6) & (grid_pos <= 20) & active)[0]
            if len(cand) >= 2:
                n_hit = int(rng.integers(2, min(5, len(cand)) + 1))
                hit = rng.choice(cand, size=n_hit, replace=False)
                for h in hit:
                    if rng.random() < 0.32:
                        ret_counts[h] += 1
                        nc_counts[h] += 1
                        active[h] = False
                    else:
                        pace[h] += rng.uniform(0.35, 1.6)
                        start_pos[h] += rng.uniform(0.8, 3.5)

        will_ret = active & (rng.random(N) < ret_p)
        early = np.zeros(N, dtype=bool)
        late = np.zeros(N, dtype=bool)
        for i in np.where(will_ret)[0]:
            if rng.random() < 0.86:
                early[i] = True
            else:
                late[i] = True
        for i in np.where(early)[0]:
            ret_counts[i] += 1
            nc_counts[i] += 1
            active[i] = False

        still = np.where(active)[0]
        if still.size == 0:
            dns_counts += is_dns.astype(np.int64)
            dsq_counts += is_dsq.astype(np.int64)
            continue

        luck = rng.normal(0, par["noise"], N)
        if regime == "green":
            # Pole + fastest car controls a green Baku more than raw 0.05s race delta implies
            luck[IDX["RUS"]] -= 0.18
        elif regime == "single":
            luck[IDX["ANT"]] -= rng.uniform(0.00, 0.28)
            luck[IDX["VER"]] -= rng.uniform(0.00, 0.16)
            if rng.random() < 0.20:
                luck[IDX["RUS"]] += rng.uniform(0.12, 0.48)
                luck[IDX["LEC"]] -= rng.uniform(0.04, 0.22)
                luck[IDX["PIA"]] -= rng.uniform(0.04, 0.22)
        else:
            luck[IDX["ANT"]] -= rng.uniform(0.08, 0.50)
            luck[IDX["VER"]] -= rng.uniform(0.04, 0.28)

        score = pace + par["stick"] * (start_pos - 1.0) + luck
        score[late] += 8.0 + rng.normal(0, 0.25, N)[late]

        order = still[np.argsort(score[still])]
        for rank, i in enumerate(order):

        ret_counts[late] += 1
        dns_counts += is_dns.astype(np.int64)
        dsq_counts += is_dsq.astype(np.int64)

    return pos_counts, nc_counts, dns_counts, dsq_counts, ret_counts

nc = nc_counts.astype(float) / N_SIM
dns = dns_counts.astype(float) / N_SIM
dsq = dsq_counts.astype(float) / N_SIM
ret = ret_counts.astype(float) / N_SIM

# Normalize drivers to 1 in float
for i in range(N):
    s = pos[i].sum() + nc[i] + dns[i] + dsq[i]

def print_summary(pos, nc, dns, dsq, ret, tag=""):
    print(f"\n===== {tag} =====")
    wins = sorted([(DRIVERS[i], pos[i,0]) for i in range(N)], key=lambda x: -x[1])
    print("WINS", ", ".join(f"{d} {w:.4f}" for d,w in wins[:10]), "sum", sum(w for _,w in wins))
    print(f"{'id':4} {'win':7} {'pod':7} {'t5':7} {'t10':7} {'ret':7} {'expC':6} {'nc':7} {'dns':6} {'sum':7}")
    for i,d in enumerate(DRIVERS):
        s = pos[i].sum()
        exp = (pos[i] * np.arange(1,23)).sum() / s if s>0 else 99
        tot = pos[i].sum()+nc[i]+dns[i]+dsq[i]
        print(f"{d:4} {pos[i,0]:7.4f} {pos[i,:3].sum():7.4f} {pos[i,:5].sum():7.4f} {pos[i,:10].sum():7.4f} {ret[i]:7.4f} {exp:6.2f} {nc[i]:7.4f} {dns[i]:6.4f} {tot:7.5f}")
    occ = pos.sum(axis=0)
    print("OCC", " ".join(f"{occ[k]:.4f}" for k in range(22)))
    print("Eclass", occ.sum(), "Enc", nc.sum(), "Edns", dns.sum(), "Edsq", dsq.sum(), "Eret", ret.sum())
    order = sorted(range(N), key=lambda i: (pos[i]*np.arange(1,23)).sum()/max(pos[i].sum(),1e-12))
    print("ORDER", [DRIVERS[i] for i in order])

print_summary(pos, nc, dns, dsq, ret, "RAW")

# ---- rounding to 5 d.p. with constraint repair ----
ND = 5
scale = 10 ** ND

def to_int_mass(p):
    """Convert probabilities to integer counts of 1e-5 that sum correctly."""
    x = np.round(p * scale).astype(np.int64)
    return x

pos_i = to_int_mass(pos)
nc_i = to_int_mass(nc)
dns_i = to_int_mass(dns)
dsq_i = to_int_mass(dsq)
ret_i = to_int_mass(ret)

# Fix each driver sum to scale
for i in range(N):
    s = pos_i[i].sum() + nc_i[i] + dns_i[i] + dsq_i[i]
    diff = scale - s
    if diff != 0:
        j = int(np.argmax(pos_i[i]))
        pos_i[i, j] += diff

# Force P1..P10 occupancy == scale if we have enough mass, else leave
# First: if a position total > scale, shave from smallest contributors with mass
for k in range(22):
    tot = pos_i[:, k].sum()
    while tot > scale:
        # shave 1 from the driver with largest mass on this pos among those who can move to nc
        i = int(np.argmax(pos_i[:, k]))
        if pos_i[i, k] <= 0:
            break
        pos_i[i, k] -= 1
        nc_i[i] += 1
        tot -= 1

# Monotonic occupancy: occ[k] >= occ[k+1]
occ = pos_i.sum(axis=0)
for k in range(21):
    while occ[k+1] > occ[k]:
        i = int(np.argmax(pos_i[:, k+1]))
        if pos_i[i, k+1] <= 0:
            break
        pos_i[i, k+1] -= 1
        nc_i[i] += 1
        occ[k+1] -= 1

# Driver sums again
for i in range(N):
    s = pos_i[i].sum() + nc_i[i] + dns_i[i] + dsq_i[i]
    diff = scale - int(s)
    if diff > 0:
        nc_i[i] += diff
    elif diff < 0:
        # remove from nc first then tail
        take = -diff
        t = min(nc_i[i], take)
        nc_i[i] -= t
        take -= t
        k = 21
        while take > 0 and k >= 0:
            t = min(pos_i[i, k], take)
            pos_i[i, k] -= t
            take -= t
            k -= 1

# Clip negatives
pos_i = np.clip(pos_i, 0, scale)
nc_i = np.clip(nc_i, 0, scale)
dns_i = np.clip(dns_i, 0, scale)
dsq_i = np.clip(dsq_i, 0, scale)
ret_i = np.clip(ret_i, 0, scale)

pos_r = pos_i / scale
nc_r = nc_i / scale
dns_r = dns_i / scale
dsq_r = dsq_i / scale
ret_r = ret_i / scale

# Final driver sum repair in float 5dp
for i in range(N):
    s = np.round(pos_r[i].sum() + nc_r[i] + dns_r[i] + dsq_r[i], ND)
    diff = np.round(1.0 - s, ND)
    if diff != 0:
        nc_r[i] = np.round(nc_r[i] + diff, ND)

print_summary(pos_r, nc_r, dns_r, dsq_r, ret_r, "ROUNDED")

# constraint checks
print("\nCHECKS")
for i,d in enumerate(DRIVERS):
    s = pos_r[i].sum()+nc_r[i]+dns_r[i]+dsq_r[i]
    if abs(s-1)>1e-8 or np.any(pos_r[i]<0) or nc_r[i]<0:
        print("BAD driver", d, s, pos_r[i].min(), nc_r[i])
occ = pos_r.sum(0)
print("max pos tot", occ.max(), "min P1-10", occ[:10].min())
print("mono", np.all(occ[1:] <= occ[:-1] + 1e-12))
print("win sum", occ[0])

np.savez("/workspace/baku_raw.npz", pos=pos_r, nc=nc_r, dns=dns_r, dsq=dsq_r, ret=ret_r)
with open("/workspace/drivers.json","w") as f:
    json.dump(DRIVERS, f)
print("saved")

{"command":"python3 - << 'PY'
import json, numpy as np
z=np.load('/workspace/baku_raw.npz')
DRIVERS=json.load(open('/workspace/drivers.json'))
pos,nc,dns,dsq,ret=z['pos'],z['nc'],z['dns'],z['dsq'],z['ret']

def f(x):
    return float(np.round(x,5))

drivers={}
for i,d in enumerate(DRIVERS):
    drivers[d]={
        "positions":[f(x) for x in pos[i]],
        "nc":f(nc[i]),
        "dns":f(dns[i]),
        "dsq":f(dsq[i]),
        "retirement":f(ret[i]),
    }

out={"event_id":"2026-15-azerbaijan","drivers":drivers}
# keep key order as in template
order_keys=["NOR","PIA","RUS","ANT","VER","HAD","LEC","HAM","ALB","SAI","LIN","LAW","STR","ALO","OCO","BEA","HUL","BOR","GAS","COL","PER","BOT"]
drivers2={k:drivers[k] for k in order_keys}
out["drivers"]=drivers2

with open('/output/prediction.json','w') as fh:
    json.dump(out, fh, indent=2)
    fh.write('\n')

# validate
p=json.load(open('/output/prediction.json'))
ids=list(p['drivers'])
assert set(ids)==set(DRIVERS)
print('n drivers', len(ids))
for d,v in p['drivers'].items():
    s=sum(v['positions'])+v['nc']+v['dns']+v['dsq']
    assert abs(s-1)<1e-8, (d,s)
    assert len(v['positions'])==22
    assert all(0<=x<=1 for x in v['positions'])
    for k in ('nc','dns','dsq','retirement'):
        assert 0<=v[k]<=1
occ=[sum(p['drivers'][d]['positions'][k] for d in p['drivers']) for k in range(22)]
print('occ', [round(x,5) for x in occ])
assert all(x<=1+1e-9 for x in occ)
assert all(occ[k+1]<=occ[k]+1e-9 for k in range(21))
print('win sum', round(occ[0],10))
print('OK')
PY"}

# 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix (Baku) — pre-race forecast

Round 15, Saturday 26 September 2026, 51 laps of the 6.003 km Baku City Circuit.
Weekend brought forward one day for Azerbaijan’s Day of Remembrance. Forecast is after qualifying and grid penalties, before the race.

## Grid (after penalties)

1 Russell (Mercedes) 1:42.526  
2 Leclerc (Ferrari) +0.837  
3 Piastri (McLaren) +0.838  
4 Hadjar (Red Bull) +0.974  
5 Norris (McLaren) +1.146  
6 Hamilton (Ferrari) +1.332  
7 Gasly (Alpine) +1.521  
8 Verstappen (Red Bull) +1.555 (Q3 not representative)  
9 Colapinto (Alpine)  
10 Bearman (Haas)  
11 Lawson (Racing Bulls)  
12 Albon (Williams)  
13 Ocon (Haas)  
14 Sainz (Williams, 5-place yellow-flag penalty; qualified 9th)  
15 Lindblad (Racing Bulls)  
16 Antonelli (Mercedes, Q1 crash, no Q2 time)  
17 Bortoleto (Audi)  
18 Hulkenberg (Audi)  
19 Bottas (Cadillac)  
20 Perez (Cadillac, 3-place impeding penalty)  
21 Alonso (Aston Martin, PU components, back of grid)  
22 Stroll (Aston Martin, PU components, back of grid)

Hadjar returns after missing NED/ITA/ESP with a wrist injury. Lawson is back at Racing Bulls.

## Championship (after Madrid)

Antonelli 292, Russell 211 (−81), Hamilton 191, Norris 186, Leclerc 167, Verstappen 145, Piastri 120. Mercedes 503 in constructors. Antonelli has eight wins; Russell two.

## Pace picture

Mercedes dominated Thursday (Russell FP1/FP2). Verstappen nicked FP3 by 0.099s. Qualifying then split: Russell produced a 0.837s pole — biggest 2026 Mercedes one-lap win — while Antonelli clipped the T1 inside wall in Q1.

F1-compiled long runs tell a different story than that pole lap:

| Team | Est. race gap |
| Mercedes | — |
| McLaren | +0.05s |
| Red Bull | +0.30s |
| Ferrari | +0.34s |
| Alpine | +0.99s |

Russell’s own Thursday comment was that race pace looked closely matched with McLaren and Red Bull. Leclerc’s P2 used tows; Ferrari still trails on the straight. Verstappen was down on power throughout qualifying (~0.5s to Hadjar, 11 km/h down the trap) plus a battery abort and Norris’s yellow. Hadjar’s P4 is genuine but he was cautious on a sore wrist and worried about Red Bull launches into a long T1.

## Race character

Dry, ~26°C air, track ~43°C, 0% rain. Wind calmer than Friday’s 65 km/h quali gusts (race gusts ~43 km/h). Pirelli C3 hard / C4 medium / C5 soft; one-stop favoured, all three compounds live, hard may be ignored. Pit windows wide. 2026 active aero and energy deployment should help passing on the 2.2 km straight relative to older Baku, but the castle section remains a wall.

Unlike Madrid, this is not a processional prior. Baku combines real main-straight passing with a high genuine SC rate (Pirelli’s historical SC figure here is very high; model uses ~76% at least one SC/red rather than 89%, to avoid Madrid-style overfit).

## Model

280k-race Monte Carlo:

- Grid after penalties, with Red Bull start losses (Hadjar, Verstappen) and a T1 pack-damage draw.
- Three interruption regimes: green (~24%), single SC/VSC pit lottery (~44%), multi-SC/red (~32%).
- 68% chance Verstappen’s power is restored overnight.
- Driver-specific mechanical and wall hazards. Extra DNS/mechanical DNF for Antonelli (FP1 hydraulic + fire-damaged PU change + Q1 crash rebuild) following the Madrid Hamilton miss. Elevated Aston–Honda and Cadillac DNF priors held.
- Most retirements are NC; a minority of late stoppages still classify.

Headline probabilities (classified P1 / podium / top 10 / retirement):

| Driver | P(win) | P(podium) | P(top 10) | P(retirement) |
| Russell | 42.8% | 67.1% | 86.5% | 12.1% |
| Piastri | 17.6% | 58.9% | 85.4% | 12.9% |
| Norris | 12.1% | 48.7% | 85.1% | 13.2% |
| Leclerc | 9.6% | 45.4% | 83.6% | 14.1% |
| Antonelli | 5.7% | 18.7% | 73.6% | 23.0% |
| Verstappen | 4.5% | 18.3% | 80.6% | 15.9% |
| Hamilton | 3.7% | 18.7% | 80.6% | 15.8% |
| Hadjar | 3.2% | 17.2% | 77.7% | 18.7% |

Expected classified finishers ≈ 18.2 of 22. P1–P10 almost always filled; P22 occupancy ~1.6%.

## Grid vs call

Material departures: Piastri and Norris over Leclerc (McLaren race pace vs Ferrari, 0.001s quali gap between PIA and LEC); Norris and Hamilton over Hadjar (Red Bull launches + rust); Verstappen over Gasly (true pace, if the PU is even partly healthy); Antonelli from 16th to ~8th (Mercedes delta on a passing straight, SC-dependent for more). Track position holds from Gasly/Colapinto through the Williams/Audi/Cadillac/Aston group, with only small Haas/Racing Bulls swaps.

Antonelli himself said this is harder to overtake than Monza. The call is a points-to-P6 recovery if the car lasts, not a 19th-to-first repeat.
EOF
